svg.text: The three flows a reviewer should trace. Note which lifelines never touch the data layer.
The catalogue reaches the browser without the frontend ever opening a database connection.
identity verified before app code runs
Responsible AI and policy verification applied at the boundary
An append, not an update. No lock, and no lost write when several instances accept votes at once.
append fct_vote via the Storage Write API
event_id is the dedupe key; the count is derived at read time
optimistic UI update, cache key invalidated
The only flow that reaches a model. Nothing from the data layer travels with the prompt.
task description typed by the user
forward, after PII screening and prompt-injection defence
approved governed enterprise model; no Vodafone data used for training

The Frontend lifeline and the BigQuery lifeline are never joined by an arrow in any flow. Every data and model operation crosses the AI Orchestration Gateway carrying the end user's own token, so authorisation is evaluated per person rather than per service account.
